clue.text: Drug user's problem, being short of vitamin supplement

clue.text: Artist ideally is given regular exposure

explanation.surface: A painter who would ideally be on show regularly.

explanation.walkthrough: Take I (one) out of AIRWOMAN and rearrange the remaining ARWOMAN.

clue.text: How poet laureate's position was described in 2010, and is still

definitions.text: How poet laureate's position was described in 2010
definitions.meaning: Andrew Motion's term as Poet Laureate ended in 2009, so the post was then without him

explanation.walkthrough: Andrew Motion was the UK's Poet Laureate, 1999-2009; after him the post was briefly 'Motion-less'.

clue.text: Young man turned up at house with missing person

clue.text: Conservative baroness is elevated after conflict

clue.text: Group pens short song having poetic features

parts.note: a hymn is a song of praise

clue.text: Article breaches copyright — editor given stick

indicators.note: the article breaks into the joined pair of abbreviations, splitting them

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for copyright, as in the symbol
an is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A newspaper piece infringes copyright, and the editor gets a beating for it.
explanation.definitionFit: To be caned is to be beaten with a cane, which is to be given the stick.

clue.text: Words from a sort of preacher receiving purest convert?

explanation.walkthrough: 'convert' poses as a noun for the newly faithful but is the anagram signal.

clue.text: Works hard making Cornish pasties perhaps

parts.note: Cornwall lies in the South West of England, abbreviated SW

clue.text: Brother wearing one will hide nothing!

definitions.text: Brother wearing one will hide nothing!

indicators.note: the word for a brother conceals the round letter within it

parts.note: a monk is a brother in a religious order
O looks like zero, nothing
someone wearing a hat is in it
the Roman numeral for one is I

explanation.surface: A cheeky warning: a friar in this swimwear would conceal nothing.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines too: a one-piece bottom with no top hides little, and a monk wearing it would be on show.
explanation.definitionFit: A monokini is a topless swimsuit, just the bottom half of a bikini, so it covers very little.

clue.text: A sordid TV broadcast introducing female interviewer

clue.text: Story about Mafioso likely to go unpunished?

clue.text: Some work by British composer

parts.note: the erg is a unit of work in physics

explanation.walkthrough: 'by' means beside, so the abbreviation sits next to the unit.

clue.text: Report about installing version of Windows, with an increase in capacity

indicators.note: the report takes the two pieces inside it, as software is installed
turned about, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: a report is a loud noise, like a gunshot

explanation.walkthrough: 'Report' means a bang, not a document; 'about' turns it round and 'installing' holds the two pieces inside, with 'with' only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Expansion means growth, such as an enlargement of capacity.

clue.text: About noon, mostly welcomed a drink

indicators.note: the shortened word goes around the letter for noon
most of the word, losing its last letter

parts.note: to greet is to welcome

clue.text: Draft of proposed law one party rejected at length

parts.note: the Lib Dems, or Liberals, are a British political party

clue.text: Gather fruit, topping for Belgian waffle

clue.text: To cover sports outfit, son put on long trousers perhaps

clue.text: Writer to enjoy good position?

to be seated comfortably, perched in a fine spot

clue.text: Wriggle out of court order served on ambassador

parts.note: a writ is an order issued by a court

clue.text: High-flier's skill as a songwriter?

an air is a tune and craft is skill, so tune-making skill

clue.text: Face paint making scoundrel appear slightly different

parts.note: a rogue is a scoundrel

clue.text: Dairy product, note, on the turn

parts.note: a tenner is a ten-pound note

clue.text: Cook French-style, turning out really nice starters

throwing out, so the opening letters are removed from the mix

clue.text: Wireless technology down: signal ultimately weakish?

clue.text: Junk food?

clue.text: High peak visible during severe storms
